# Addlink A92 2 TB

The Addlink A92 is a solid-state drive in the M.2 2280 form factor, launched on October 7th, 2021. It is available in capacities ranging from 1 TB to 4 TB. This page reports specifications for the 2 TB variant. With the rest of the system, the Addlink A92 interfaces using a PCI-Express 4.0 x4 connection. The SSD controller is the PS5016-E16-32 from Phison, a DRAM cache chip is available. Addlink has installed 96-layer QLC NAND flash on the A92, the flash chips are made by Micron. To improve write speeds, a pseudo-SLC cache is used, so bursts of incoming writes are processed more quickly. Thanks to support for the fast PCI-Express 4.0 interface, performance is excellent. The A92 is rated for sequential read speeds of up to 4,850 MB/s and 3,600 MB/s write; random IOPS reach up to 350K for reads and 700K for writes. At its launch, the SSD was priced at 267 USD. The warranty length is set to five years, which is an excellent warranty period. Addlink guarantees an endurance rating of 400 TBW, a relatively low value compared to other SSDs.

Title: Addlink AddGame A95, A90, and A92 M.2 PCIe 4.0 Up to 4TB SSD for Sony PS5 Game Console - StorageNewsletter
URL: https://www.storagenewsletter.com/2021/10/19/addlink-addgame-a95-a90-and-a92-m-2-pcie-4-0-up-to-4tb-ssd-for-sony-ps5-game-console/
Published: 2021-10-19T00:00:00.000Z
Author: N/A
Highlights:
Addlink Technology announced the AddGame A95, A90, and A92 M.2 PCIe 4.0. a range of SSD solution with heatsink that is ready for the Sony PS5 Game Console.

...

The company’s AddGame A95, A90, and A92 M.2 NVMe Gen4x4 SSDs are compatible and exceed all requirements for PS5 Game Console expansion slot. They come with ‘Premium Heatsinks’ that use not only high-grade aluminum, but the Shark-Fin design also brings the cooling feature to the next level. Moreover, the low-profile design makes these 3 models only has a height of 9.1mm, which will fit into the PS5’s internal expansion slot.

...

The A90 model is equipped with a TLC flash for extreme endurance, a DRAM cache buffer that enables sequential R/W speeds of up to 5GB/4.4GB/s on PCs. For PS5 console, A90 can also deliver 5.6GB/s in read speed. Combining performance, endurance, and a more economical price, A90 is also another option for PS5 gamers.

A92 budget-friendly Gen 4×4 SSDs The AddGame A92 is the Gen4x4 SSD with QLC flash that delivers the R/W speed of up to 4.9/3.6GB/s on PCs. For PS5, A92 has the same performance of 5.6GB/s as the A90 model.

The 3D QLC NAND storage technology incorporates a much higher memory cell density for larger storage capacity on a smaller footprint, which makes the A92 way more affordable even with the 4TB capacity.

A95 vs. A90. Vs. A92 comparison chart

Both the A95 and A92 models are available in capacity of 1, 2 and 4TB. For A90 model, it comes with 1 and 2TB varieties. 

Furthermore, besides the 5-year limited warranty, all 3 models also come with free company’s Toolbox software that allows users to monitor their SSDs on PC.

## SSD compatible PS5 - A Series GEN4X4 format NVMe

 Les disques SSD AddGame A series en format NVMe Gen 4x4 sont prêts pour devenir votre SSD PS5. Les SSD A Series sont en interface PCIe 4.0 NVMe 1.4 et dotés d'un radiateur " heatsink" premium composé d'aluminium de haute qualité, dans un format ultra fin. Le pad de gel en silice offre une conductivité parfaite de la chaleur pour des performances de refroidissement de haut niveau. Avec seuleument 9.1mm de hauteur pour le heatsink, ces disques SSDs s'emboitent parfaitement dans le slot interne de la PS5 dédié aux extensions de stockage. 

### La puissance du Gen 4x4

Avec la toute dernière interface en PCIe Gen4x4 NVMe 1.4, le AddGame A92 délivre des performances atteignant les 4900Mo/s en lecture. Ils sont également compatibles avec les interfaces en PCIe Gen3x4.

### Un radiateur optimisé

Avec leurs armures façon diamant et leurs heatsinks en aluminium finement découpé, les disques SSD AddGame A series dispersent la chaleur 17% plus efficacement qu'un autre SSD. Avec la pâte thermique en silice, ces SSDs sont capables de conserver de hautes performances sans risque de thermal throttling (ou étranglement thermique). Tout cet équipement de protection permet une meilleure durée de vie du disque.

### Un concentré de technologie

Les disques AddGame A series sont équipés d'un contrôleur derière génération en Gen4x4 NVMe 1.4, de mémoire Flash 3D. En combinaison avec le DRAM Cache Buffer, la technologie SLC Caching améliore les performances. Technologie LDPC ECC, protection thermique adaptative, 5 ans de garantie : vos données seront en sécurité, que ce soit pour les tâches intensives ou le hardcore gaming.

### Stockage rapide pour PS5

Les disques SSD Addlink sont compatibles PS5. Disponibles en 1To, 2To et 4To, leur radiateur low-profile pour une hauteur totale de 9.1mm se glisse parfaitement dans le slot d'extension de la PlayStation 5.
